mortality_check.observation: The German cold/heat comparison is roughly consistent with original Table 2. Some other country rows imply larger ratios than the preceding Europe-wide range.
mortality_check.scope_limit: The citation immediately follows the German sentence. The study estimates selected urban populations aged 20 or older, not whole national populations. This is not a matched proof that the broad national assertion is false.
mortality_check.read_extent: Selected abstract/methods on physical 1–4, Table 2 on physical 6, and discussion/limitations on physical 7–10 through web. Not full statistical appendix review.
mortality_check.editorial_status_limit: PubMed records a February 8, 2024 Expression of Concern (PMID 38342130, DOI 10.1016/S2542-5196(24)00022-6). Its reasons and final resolution were not verified. No inference of retraction or invalidity is made.

life_expectancy_check.reason: Resident and total-population GBD estimates differ. Singapore MOH September 8, 2026 reports GBD total-population life expectancy 85.4 in 2023 and explicitly distinguishes resident estimates; Singapore resident life tables report a different value. Without a stated population, year and standardisation, comparison with German resident life tables is not a proved false five-year gap.
life_expectancy_check.read_extent: Selected official primary notice passages through web; not archived locally.

limits: No conclusion about whether climate change reduces future mortality or the merits of BEHG abolition. No new submission quotations added; the separate binding-targets lead remains unresolved.
